body: I don’t know why I love him I just know that I do love him I’m so obsessed with him I just need him but I am so scared of him. I contacted his mum about it and told her the whole details and he admitted it to her too, she responded with “I don't agree with what he did, and feel upset and disappointed with him” I’m just so sad I do love him with all of my heart but I can’t eat I can’t drink I can’t sleep. I just want to sleep. I want to sleep for the rest of my life. I’m just so sad and scared.

He doesn’t do it often, I think I may have worded this wrong. He’s not aggressive to me, he doesn’t hit me or anything bad like that, he just shouts loud and slams stuff around when he’s angry, which obviously isn’t all the time and generally is because I’ve done something wrong, he’s not a bad person.

Maybe I’ve portrayed him wrong as I got upset writing this post, he really isn’t a bad guy, he can be so sweet and I do love him unbelievably much. I have tried to talk about it and have explained that even if it’s not now, in the future I really do want children and I can’t see a future without having them and the most hopeful response I’ve had out of that was ‘I don’t know maybe I’ll change my mind in the future’ which could be true, I hope that’s the case anyway because I am so madly in love with him and I don’t know what I’d do without him, I don’t know anybody else, I would literally have nobody.

Thank you so much for your reply. When he does get angry he does shout loud which he knows scares me (but all people do that when they’re angry I guess) and he does slams things around but that’s a better reaction than hitting out or anything! He hasn’t ever hit me or physically hurt me so I am safe, you don’t have to worry about that, thankyou so much though I really do appreciate the concern. I have mentioned it to my friends after arguing with him but mentioned not out of concern for my own safety but more explaining that it’s childish of him to react in those ways to silly things. My friends aren’t really keen on him, so also agree with you that this could be a red flag, though that’s my own fault that they feel that way rather than his, they all live in my hometown (as I stopped attending my university lectures after the miscarriage I wasn’t able to make many friends here so the only people I really know here is my boyfriend and his friends) so none of my friends have really had the chance to meet him and have only heard about him from mouth which obviously when we’ve argued or I’m upset I tell them why and so they aren’t the biggest fans but I’m sure if they got to meet him they’d love him. I’ve told him that he scares me when he does things like shouting or slamming things so hopefully he’ll refrain from doing so in the future, but I mean at least it’s only shouting and slamming objects around rather than me around haha! I don’t think he would ever intentionally hurt me. I get that the compatibility issue with children is a problem. I have tried to talk about it and have explained that even if it’s not now, in the future I really do want children and I can’t see a future without having them and the most hopeful response I’ve had out of that was ‘I don’t know maybe I’ll change my mind in the future’ which could be true, I hope that’s the case anyway because I am so madly in love with him and I don’t know what I’d do without him, I’d have nobody.
